description: Agentic tool to create a new collaborative event checklist (e.g. for BBQs, camping, picnics, potlucks, dinners) with categorized items, required quantities, date, location, and host name. Returns live shareable URL and WhatsApp copy.

items.description: List of supply and food items needed

location.description: Optional venue, address, or park landmark

title.description: Event title (e.g. "Grand Saturday Braai & Rugby" or "Family Lake Picnic")

name: create_event_checklist
